That exception implies Home Assistant cannot find the correct URL that will allow the motionEye webhook to route back to itself (back to Home Assistant). Do you have an internal and external URL set under `Configuration -> General -> {Internal URL, External URL}`. If not, set those values, then restart HA (or remove/add the integration) and see if you still have the issue?
